headline: Visual Designer
tagline: Visual designer with hands-on experience producing 100+ brand assets and building reusable design templates for corporate communications.

skills.label: Design & Visuals

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders to manage low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready file requirements including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Utilized AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and fed findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Executed wireframing and prototyping for digital interfaces.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff using Photoshop and Illustrator.

projects.name: Social campaign for a fashion brand
